observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale on a checkerboard. Each shows the same glossy black, segmented arthropod on long, thin, jointed legs that end in hooked claws. The joints are rimmed in dark red. A large rear abdomen shows a dull red-orange glow through cracked plates. South: the head faces the camera, with two small glowing red eyes, curved mandibles, and swollen red glowing lobes on either side behind the head. East: a side profile, with the bulbous glowing abdomen at the left, a segmented thorax arching forward, and a small head with a red eye and hooked mandibles at the right. North: the rear, showing the rounded abdomen split down the middle into two glowing halves, with the thorax tapering away beyond it. No face is visible. The three facings are about the same height.
observed.south.png: Front view. A small wedge-shaped black head points at the camera, with two red eyes and three or four hooked mouthparts. Behind it, a domed segmented carapace is flanked by two swollen glands glowing ember-red. About eight long, thin black legs splay outward and down in a crouched hunting stance. The background is clean white/alpha.
observed.east.png: Side profile. A long, ant-like segmented black body with a very large rounded rear abdomen glowing deep red-orange through plated chitin. The head is low and forward, with a red eye and hooked mandibles. Six or seven long, thin, multi-jointed legs lift the body high off the ground in a lean, stalking stance. Clean cut-out with no ground shadow.
observed.north.png: Rear view. The big rounded abdomen fills the centre, divided by a vertical seam into two glowing ember-red lobes. A dark segmented thorax rises beyond it. Long, thin legs splay to both sides. No eyes or face. Clean cut-out.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the creature spans about 2.5–3 cells long and stands roughly 1.5× the height of the vanilla human, well above a crouching man's size. At 32 px/cell it reads clearly as a dark, spidery, long-legged shape with a red glowing rear, distinct from the brown ground.

observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale on a checkerboard. Each shows one rotund blue-furred primate walking on all fours or knuckles. It has a cream belly banded with blue stripes, orange-yellow patches on the shoulders and back, and a flat face with a yellow-orange brow and red cheeks. The tail is a long thin cord banded blue, orange and red, ending in a large egg-shaped bulb striped red, yellow and blue that rests on the ground. South faces the camera, east is a walking side profile facing right, and north shows the back and rump with the tail rising from the base of the spine. There is no branch, perch, ornament or second animal.
observed.south.png: Front view of the primate, face toward the camera. It has hunched shoulders and a heavy head with an orange-yellow brow and red cheek stripes. A cream pot-belly is banded with blue. Its very long arms reach the ground, ending in dark curved claws. Its short legs end in yellow feet with dark claws. The tail runs out to screen left and ends in a rainbow bulb. Painterly fur texture with a thin dark outline. Clean alpha.
observed.east.png: True side profile walking right. The head is low and forward, with a mandrill-like yellow-orange face and red nose and cheek. The back is hunched, the long arms reach the ground with curled dark claws, and the belly is round and striped. The thin tail arcs back and down to a rainbow bulb on the ground. One animal only. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: Rear view showing the back of the head (blue fur, a small orange patch, no face or eyes), broad shoulders with orange-yellow patches, and a blue rump. The tail rises from the base of the spine and curves down to screen left, ending in the rainbow bulb. Feet and hand claws show below. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the creature is about the human's height, or somewhat smaller, while walking on all fours. At normal play (32 px per cell) it is a small blue speck next to the human, smaller than the human's head. The tail bulb is barely visible.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South shows the face head-on with the belly toward the camera.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows the back, rump and tail root. The head is seen from behind, with no face or eyes.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three views are at the game's camera angle, none overhead.

SAME_SIZE.seen: Measured spread is 0%. The views look matched.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: The palette, striped belly, shoulder patches, long arms and tail with its rainbow bulb are the same on every view, and the tail turns with the body: it comes from behind on south, from the rump on north and trails back on east.

SIGNATURE.seen: The colourful primate with a round pot-belly is clearly shown.

ALIEN.seen: The face recalls a mandrill, but the all-blue fur, striped belly, long cord tail with its rainbow bulb and very long arms mark it as not an Earth animal.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1) One animal alone, with no branch, perch or ornament: present. 2) Colourful furred primate: present. 3) Round pot-belly: present.

CANON.seen: Body plan: pot-bellied, hunched, heavy head, arms much longer than the legs, long dark claws; the branch perch is not possible in-engine and departure 1 forbids it. Colour layout: blue fur, a cream belly banded with blue, orange and yellow patches, a mandrill-like face with a yellow brow and red stripes. Tail: long thin cord ending in a striped red-yellow-blue bulb. The rendering is realistic and painterly. It is not a plain monkey.

STYLE.seen: Painterly fur strokes with a thin dark outline. The face is stern, not cute. Somewhat illustrative but within the vanilla style.

OURS.seen: A custom drawing matching the description, not vanilla or donor art.

ALPHA.seen: Transparent background, no ground or shadow on any view.

SCALE.seen: About a human's size at max zoom, which suits a primate kept as an exotic pet. The description gives no size words.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px it reads as a small blue blob. The tail bulb is just visible. Small but distinct from the ground.
